# Code of Conduct

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.vi.md)

## Our commitment

We are committed to making participation in this project respectful, constructive and welcoming.

## Expected behavior

- Be respectful and technically specific.
- Critique ideas and implementations, not people.
- Share reproducible evidence when making technical claims.
- Protect credentials, private logs and sensitive information.
- Respect licensing and upstream project boundaries.

## Unacceptable behavior

Harassment, discrimination, threats, doxxing, deliberate disruption, credential exposure and bad-faith participation are not acceptable.

## Enforcement

Report conduct concerns privately to:

`Đăng Khoa <i.am@dangkhoa.dev>`

Reports will be reviewed in context and handled proportionately.
